summary: Same-agent review of the committed Writer table value implementation and shared Calc data-style evidence against the pinned sources.
findings: Original ODT fixtures preserve string value precedence, cached numeric values, and explicit formula errors through their covered boundaries.
The format mutation path binds the direct formula item before notification and Worker rehydrates its actual document formatter.
The expanded Writer profile had four timeout-only failures and the same four cases passed in focused retries.
evidence_refs: d354649d7636 and 6df3d2520caa: 26 Writer value/core tests, 8 shared XML table tests, 31 Calc tests, expanded Writer profile plus four successful retries, and office typecheck
residual_risks: The Writer table engine preserves imported formula text and cached values and handles the explicit missing-box marker. General formula evaluation and table-cell paragraph and character style groups remain open.
